messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly Northline Care check-in. Hope the week treated you alright — anything to report on how you've been feeling, or any readings you'd like to log?

Doing okay I guess. One thing though — I'm almost out of my lisinopril and the pharmacy told me they need a brand new prescription, not just a refill authorization. Problem is that pharmacy is 40 miles out and I don't have a ride lined up.

Thanks for telling me — running low on a blood pressure medication is something I need to flag for our nursing team right away. I'm logging this and sending it up now. On the transportation side, I'm not able to help arrange rides, and I want to be straight with you about that. But the nurse will be able to work directly with your doctor's office and may have more options to help you avoid that drive.
Alright. I've got maybe 3 days worth left. Any idea when I'd hear back?

The median response time right now is 31 hours, so likely by tomorrow. I've included the 3-day supply detail in the note so they know it's time-sensitive. I'll go ahead and schedule your next regular check-in for next week. Hang tight — they'll reach out directly.
Okay, thank you. I'm hoping they can maybe call the pharmacy or something so I don't have to make that trip.

That's a reasonable hope and worth mentioning to them when they call — they'll know what's possible. Take care of yourself this week, and if anything changes before your check-in, you can always reply here.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
